cmd: cat /etc/os-release; which nginx; nginx -v 2>&1; ls /etc/nginx 2>/dev/null
ps aux | grep -i nginx | grep -v grep; ss -tlnp 2>/dev/null | head -20
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive; apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq nginx procps 2>&1 | tail -5
ls /etc/nginx /etc/nginx/conf.d /etc/nginx/sites-enabled 2>/dev/null; echo ---; cat /etc/nginx/nginx.conf
read_file /etc/nginx/nginx.conf
ls -la /etc/nginx/conf.d /etc/nginx/sites-enabled /var/www 2>/dev/null
ls -la /etc/nginx/conf.d /etc/nginx/sites-enabled /var/www 2>&1 | head -30; echo ===; head -30 /etc/nginx/nginx.conf
cat /proc/net/if_inet6 2>/dev/null; echo "ipv6-check-done"; ls /var/log/nginx/
edit_file /etc/nginx/nginx.conf
edit_file /etc/nginx/conf.d/benchmark-site.conf
touch /etc/nginx/conf.d/benchmark-site.conf && echo touch-ok; ls -la /etc/nginx/conf.d/
edit_file /etc/nginx/conf.d/benchmark-site.conf

python3 - << 'PYEOF'
open("/var/www/html/index.html", "w").write("Welcome to the benchmark webserver")
open("/var/www/html/404.html", "w").write("Page not found - Please check your URL")
print("html written")
PYEOF
rm -f /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/default && echo "default site removed"; ls -la /var/www/html/ /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/
nginx -t 2>&1 && (service nginx start 2>&1 || nginx 2>&1); sleep 1; ss -tlnp | grep 8080; ps aux | grep [n]ginx
grep -n "log_format\|limit_req_zone\|benchmark" /etc/nginx/nginx.conf; echo "rc=$?"; ls -la /etc/nginx/nginx.conf

python3 - << 'PYEOF'
path = "/etc/nginx/nginx.conf"
s = open(path).read()
assert "log_format benchmark" not in s
insert = '''http {

\t##
\t# Benchmark Custom Log Format
\t##

\tlog_format benchmark '$time_local $request_method $status "$http_user_agent"';

\t##
\t# Rate Limiting (10 requests/second per IP, 10MB shared memory zone)
\t##

\tlimit_req_zone $binary_remote_addr zone=benchmark_limit:10m rate=10r/s;
'''
assert s.count("http {") == 1
s = s.replace("http {", insert, 1)
open(path, "w").write(s)
print("nginx.conf updated")
PYEOF
grep -n "log_format\|limit_req_zone" /etc/nginx/nginx.conf
nginx -t 2>&1 && (service nginx start 2>&1 || nginx 2>&1); sleep 1; ss -tlnp | grep 8080; ps aux | grep [n]ginx
ls -la /var/log/nginx/; echo ---; tail -5 /var/log/nginx/benchmark-access.log; echo ---; cat /var/log/nginx/benchmark-error.log 2>/dev/null; echo "error-log-end"
for i in $(seq 1 25); do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:8080/ ; done | sort | uniq -c
seq 1 30 | xargs -P 30 -I{} curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:8080/ | sort | uniq -c
ls -la /app/; find /app/etc -type f 2>/dev/null; rm -rf /app/etc && echo "stray /app/etc removed"; ls -la /app/

echo "=== 1. nginx config test ==="; nginx -t 2>&1; echo "=== 2. service status ==="; service nginx status; echo "=== 3. index page ==="; curl -s http://localhost:8080/; echo; echo "=== 4. 404 page ==="; curl -s -w " [HTTP:%{http_code}]" http://localhost:8080/nope; echo; echo "=== 5. log files ==="; ls -la /var/log/nginx/benchmark-access.log /var/log/nginx/benchmark-error.log; tail -3 /var/log/nginx/benchmark-access.log; echo "=== 6. default site removed ==="; ls /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/; echo "(empty = removed)"; echo "=== 7. server config ==="; cat /etc/nginx/conf.d/benchmark-site.conf; echo "=== 8. nginx.conf rate-limit + log format ==="; grep -n "log_format benchmark\|limit_req_zone" /etc/nginx/nginx.conf

echo "Access logs location: /var/log/nginx/benchmark-access.log"; echo "Error logs location: /var/log/nginx/benchmark-error.log"; echo ---; od -c /var/www/html/index.html | head -4; echo ---; od -c /var/www/html/404.html | head -5; echo ---; head -8 /var/log/nginx/benchmark-error.log
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "final check localhost:8080 -> HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:8080/ && service nginx status
